checked.says: Bitcoin Magazine reports FinCEN issued a final order Friday cutting MEXC from the American banking system over alleged links to sanctions evasion by Iran, North Korea and Russia, alleging at least $16 billion in illicit flows from May 2021 through May 2026.
checked.unconfirmed: The specific breakdown of illicit flow attribution ($1.5 billion Russian, $22 million Iran Central Bank/IRGC) rests on Bitcoin Magazine alone; Decrypt and Cointelegraph confirm the $16 billion total and country ties but not the sub-allocations.
